title: Personal Loan Grade Points on a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan
content:
For a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan in Personal Loan Grade E, F or G takes 0.75 percentage points off the plan rate; a loan in Personal Loan Grade C or D takes 0.50 points off; a loan in Personal Loan Grade A or B takes none. The grade is the rate grade on the loan's Personal Loans record.

| Personal Loans grade | Points off the plan rate |
|---|---|
| Personal Loan Grade E | 0.75 |
| Personal Loan Grade F | 0.75 |
| Personal Loan Grade G | 0.75 |
| Personal Loan Grade C | 0.50 |
| Personal Loan Grade D | 0.50 |
| Personal Loan Grade A | none |
| Personal Loan Grade B | none |
